notes.title: New Games From Sleepless!
notes.notes:
Sleepless wants to know what *you* think about the new games that it hopes to be producing soon.

Seriously, we really, really do want to know.  

There's a high likelihood that Sleepless will be creating more games soon and we want our radiant and beloved fans to answer some questions to help guide us in what we create.  if you can be bothered, then please answer the following questions.  if you can't be bothered, then *definitely* answer them.


Question 1: As a game player, which would you prefer, A or B?

A) Spending $5 each for 16 small, yet very high quality games (like PocoMan, but frankly a lot better) 

   or 

B) Spending $80 for a single AAA mega-budget game


Question 2: There is no question 2.  Thank you!

( click "Discuss" to provide your answers )

notes.title: Partial Controller Support
notes.notes:
By the end of the weekend, PocoMan! should be updated to include support for controllers. This will not work in the pause menu, but controlling Pocoman with a game pad will be possible. The bindings are as follows:

These bindings were only tested on an Xbox one controller, although they should work similarly on most standard mapped game pads, just with different names for the buttons. Trial and error may be your friend here.

Directional Pad to move Up Down Left Right
A button is mapped to pressing the space bar ( doesn't do anything just there to move between screens )
B button is mapped to Undo
Y button is mapped to next level
X button is mapped to previous level
Start button will open the start menu
The share button (button 8) will open the help menu

Right now we are not supporting the joysticks, but I plan on adding support for those later as the left thumb stick being regular movement and the right will move the cursor for "super poco mode" which will be activated with some other button.


Also we have changed the way the level packs are loaded and everyone should now load the full classic level packs with all 34 levels.

notes.title: Pocoman Leaves Early Access
notes.notes:
[h1]We are finally ready to release Pocoman![/h1]
[i]PocoMan will leave early access on 09/01/2019[/i]

Thank you to everyone who helped with testing levels and finding bugs for us to fix. Our next step will be getting the original DLC level packs uploaded for purchase. 

Stay tuned, and thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Sleepless Has been hard at work rebuilding Pocoman and we finally have something to show for it. Here's a few features and fixes that are making their way into the game.


Added “Super Poco Mode” - Allows you to click on a tile and have Pocoman move there
Added “Oops” sound when pushing a treasure into a corner
Restructured the level selection menu to focus more on the graphics
Added “Undo” - Can now press “u” to undo the last move
Added lots of sounds for each of the levels
Added a victory screen for beating all the levels
Added three classic maps to make it easy to get started playing
Added the rest of the original classic maps
Fixed some levels like Appooz that were missing rows or tiles

We also added the groundwork for making DLC level pack like the original “Green”, “Food”, and “Daisy” packs. This will also allow us to make new packs.

notes.title: Pocoman Unleashed
notes.notes:
It's finally here! 

Pocoman is available to all windows users starting today! We look forward to growing Pocoman into the game it deserves to be and want to thank you for joining us on this journey.

Have fun,

Sleepless Inc.
